name: unnoticed-memory-spike

finding.title: `readBody` keeps two copies of the body at once, about 50 MiB at the limit
finding.description: The chunks stay alive while they are copied into a new `Uint8Array` of the same size. A body just under the 25 MiB `MAX_BODY_BYTES` therefore costs about 50 MiB before `TextDecoder` and `JSON.parse` add more, and the Worker isolate has 128 MB. This happens before the signature check, so an unsigned request can cause it.
finding.suggestedFix: Use the `Content-Length` value, when there is one, to allocate the buffer up front and write each chunk into it as it arrives. Otherwise, drop the chunk references as they are copied.
